title: Car dreams
content: We all experience bathrooms in our dreams but what is it like when you’re in a vehicle? Recently I bought an suv and I’ve been dreaming about it but always worse case scenarios. Last night I dreamt I was in a red ford truck and the breaks barely worked. I had to press all of the ways down on the floorboard for them to even engage. It was nighttime too, so it was harder to see. This time it was more so about my vehicle than the crazy roads. Which I also hate.
